# USDM test fixtures

Documents used by the USDM import tests (`tests/Cadence.UnitTests/Packages/UsdmDesignImporterTests.cs`,
[ADR-2473](../../../docs/adr/2026-09-30-usdm-4-import-into-the-protocol-design.md)).

| File | What it is | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cdisc_usdm4_full_1.json` | A complete USDM 4.0.0 study (the CDISC example "full_1") | `tests/integration_test_files/full_1.json` in [cdisc-org/usdm](https://github.com/cdisc-org/usdm) at commit `1d47f7686d0174f6cd193dada1a6effb6e52213d`, unmodified (SHA-256 `718965c91a369a56b5165766ea1272d57679f1b75d861ba8f98f7952a800714d`) |
| `cdisc_usdm4_full_1.design.json` | The protocol design the importer produces from it, with the tests' concept resolver | Generated by the import; the golden test compares against it |

Do not edit `cdisc_usdm4_full_1.json`. To refresh it, copy the file from a newer upstream commit and update the commit
and hash above. When the importer's output changes on purpose, regenerate the expected design with
`CADENCE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 dotnet test tests/Cadence.UnitTests/Cadence.UnitTests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~UsdmDesignImporterTests"`
and review the diff.
